The following menu displays a range of draft ideas made by the Logosdor team over the last couple of weeks. Everything is a very quick experiment. More a proof of concept, than anything polished and finished.

No text is refined, edited or checked. No ideas are finished.

We wanted to see what might be possible to achieve in interactive and animated pages that would engage a youth sport audience globally. The goal is for all the ideas to point towards the Scriptures.

In the end we want to know what is possible to achieve technically and which ideas achieve greater engagement with the Bible text. Obviously a digital Bible can do things that a print Bible cannot.

The following are those experiments. All in draft and mostly done in less than a day.

Enjoy!
